Kubernetes is great. Running it is a job.

In our free webinar we show what managed Kubernetes looks like in practice: NKE (Nine Kubernetes Engine) for anyone who wants standard Kubernetes with Swiss data residency, Deploio for anyone who just wants to ship without writing YAML. Live demo of both, side by side. 🎓

All sessions and registration: nine.ch/en/kubernetes-webinar/
